contract.hosted: all-zero UUID id; modelId empty; provider mikka
contract.subscription: UUID binding ID, including shared subscriptions (kind remains subscription)
contract.apiKey: apikey:<UUID key ID>:<model>; kind apiKey for own, shared for teammate key
contract.fields: kind enum, chosen boolean, modelId/provider/id strings; credentialLabel/quota/owner labels excluded

compatibilityBoundary: Journal identifier grammar is intentionally narrower than the product's trimmed custom model string. Unknown/nonidentifier values fail before configuration mutation; this is not claimed to cover every custom model string.
